First release of Topbarac, a menu bar system monitor for macOS 26 and later.

- Seven widgets: CPU, Memory, Disk, Temperature and fans, GPU, Network, Battery.
- Five panel styles per widget, warning and critical thresholds, combined mode with a tabbed popover.
- Liquid Glass popovers with live charts you can hover or step through with the arrow keys.
- Top processes in every popover: quit, force quit, kill as admin, show in Finder; an All Processes window.
- Free inactive memory, eject volumes, empty the Trash, see cache sizes.
- Alert rules with notifications that name the process to blame and offer to quit it.
- Optional on-disk history with CSV export.
